question: India's communication satellite CMS-01 was successfully launched by _______ in December 2020.
solution:
The correct answer is __**PSLV-C50**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• CMS-01 is the name of the satellite launched by ISRO using its PSLV-C50 rocket.
 
• ISRO launched a communication satellite CMS-01 which was formerly named GSAT-12R using its Polar Satellite Launch Vehicle rocket's XL variant numbered PSLV-C50 from the second launch pad at the rocket port Sriharikota.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

__
 
• CMS-01 is a communication satellite that will provide services in the Extended-C Band of the frequency spectrum, which would include the Indian mainland, Andaman and Nicobar, and Lakshadweep Islands.
 
• This is the 42nd communication satellite of India and it is expected to have a mission life of seven years.
 
• PSLV-C50 ejected CMS-01 into geosynchronous transfer orbit after 20 minutes into its flight and the satellite was taken up from there and positioned at geosynchronous stationary orbit. 
 
• The CMS-01 is a replacement for GSAT-12 that was launched in **2011** with a mission life of eight years.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Indian Space Research Organisation:**

 
 
• K. Sivan is the current chairman of the Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO).
 
• It is the space agency of the Government of India.
 
• Formation: 15 August 1969
 
• Headquarters: Bengaluru
